purpose: Sparse task-slice temporal comparison of compact_view_reinvest seeds 43022/43122 to distinguish early acquisition instability from later consolidation/noise effects.

task_groups.blimp_worst: BLiMP files where seed43122 was much below seed43022 at 100M.
task_groups.blimp_control: BLiMP files where seed43122 matched or exceeded seed43022 at 100M.
task_groups.supplement_all: All fast BLiMP Supplement slices, including QA-congruence and preserved subject-aux/turn-taking.
task_groups.ewok_all: All EWoK fast domains; the 100M seed43122 deficit is broad enough that all 11 domains are cheap and informative.
task_groups.entity_full: Full Entity Tracking data after the official evaluator skips 'nothing' options; distinguishes low-op from multi-op trajectories.
